page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the lower tiers of modern cloud hardware. In stress-ng CPU testing, the instance achieves a single-core score of 1100.98 and a multi-core score of 2934.04, both falling into the bottom 25% of tested servers. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with read-only large block transfers measuring 21.27 GB/sec and write operations at 18.88 GB/sec. These metrics indicate a hardware profile suited for workloads with modest computational and memory throughput requirements.

Real-world application benchmarks reflect these hardware constraints. The instance processes Redis SET operations at 2.87 million operations per second and delivers static web serving throughput of 2.52 GB/sec. Software compilation with Clang scores 2966.0, while text processing performance is relatively low at 1168.0. Given these characteristics, the ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is best utilized for lightweight general-purpose workloads, such as basic web serving, small-scale development environments, and low-traffic application hosting where resource density and cost efficiency are prioritized over high-performance execution.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-based instance provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It includes no local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Performance benchmarks place the instance in the lower percentiles, with a single-core Geekbench score of 928.0 and a multi-core score of 2014.0. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for workloads with modest resource demands. The ecs.sn2ne.xlarge is suitable for lightweight general-purpose applications, basic web serving, and development environments.
